changelog: - **A file with a repeated or missing group frame id opens the same way every time.** A hand-edited or damaged file whose saved frames repeated an id, or left one out, gave that frame a new id made from the clock each time it was opened. Two opens of one file gave the frame two different ids, so the document no longer matched itself, and a project revision whose header holds no content digest showed as changed the moment it opened. The replacement id is now made from the file itself: a repeat of x becomes x_2, x_3, and a missing id takes the frame's place in the file, never an id another frame of the file already has. Files Loop Studio writes, and run results, are unchanged.
